rules.label: HTML language declared
rules.description: The document should declare a language on the html element.

rules.label: Document title present
rules.description: Exactly one non-empty title element is expected.

rules.label: Meta description present
rules.description: A non-empty meta description is expected.

rules.label: Viewport metadata present
rules.description: Responsive pages should declare viewport metadata.

rules.label: Canonical URL present
rules.description: Exactly one canonical link is expected and should point to the audited page URL.

rules.label: Primary H1 present
rules.description: Exactly one H1 is normally expected; intentional exceptions may be recorded.

rules.label: No duplicate element IDs
rules.description: Element IDs should be unique within a document.

rules.label: JSON-LD parses
rules.description: Every application/ld+json block should contain valid JSON.

rules.label: Images have alt attributes
rules.description: Every img element should include an alt attribute, including empty alt for decorative images.

rules.label: Images have source paths
rules.description: Every img element should include a non-empty src attribute.

rules.label: Page title is unique in scan
rules.description: Duplicate titles across different URLs deserve curator review.

rules.label: Canonical is unique in scan
rules.description: Different pages should not claim the same canonical URL.
